item.title: Show HN: Rollcall – Simulated Film Development on iPhone with Shared Rolls
item.summary: Hey Show HN! I've been working on an idea called Rollcall, which simulates physical and film cameras and the film development process in real time rather than apply a post-processing filter or LUT to photos. You can generate any kind of camera you can think of, real, imagined, something you've used or something you always wanted to try. Shared social rolls also let friends share a film roll for an event, party, trip, whatever - and the photos only develop once the full roll has been shot. Would love to hear your thoughts and what's working or not landing for you! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49233773 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
